summary: Request for a contrib.workdir module providing a Workspace utility for local directories backed by remote storage, enabling file-based activities to scale across multiple worker instances by automatically handling upload/download operations.
userImpact: Users working with file-based activities on multiple worker instances must manually implement boilerplate for uploading to and downloading from object storage.
proposedFix: Implement a contrib.workdir module with a Workspace context manager that automatically handles pull before execution and push after, with optional @workspace decorator for automatic path retrieval and fsspec for storage backend auto-detection.
workaround: Manually download from and upload to object storage (S3/GCS) at the start and end of every activity.
resolutionDetails: Declined for SDK contrib module due to cross-SDK parity requirements, but suggested as a temporal-community project; submitted to temporal-community code exchange.
keyQuote: Generally, we try to maintain relative parity between SDKs, so we would have to replicate this work across all of them.
